govulncheck_missing: govulncheck is not installed ({detail}). Install it with: go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest (https://pkg.go.dev/golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck), put it on the PATH or in <JGATES_HOME>/tools/bin, or point JGATES_GOVULNCHECK to it. JGates never installs it during a run.
govulncheck_fix: govulncheck is supplied by you: run go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest (needs Go, https://go.dev/dl/), put the binary on the PATH or in <JGATES_HOME>/tools/bin, or set JGATES_GOVULNCHECK, then run doctor again.
govulncheck_probe_failed: govulncheck at {path} did not answer -version. Reinstall it with: go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest.
govulncheck_no_go: govulncheck needs the Go toolchain on the PATH to load the module ({detail}). Install Go from https://go.dev/dl/.
govulncheck_no_module: No go.mod was found in the scan root, so there is no Go module to analyse.
govulncheck_timeout: govulncheck exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
govulncheck_cancelled: The run was cancelled; govulncheck was stopped and its partial output was kept in the logs.
govulncheck_invalid_output: The govulncheck output is not the expected JSON stream: {detail}
govulncheck_no_invocation: The plan has no govulncheck invocation for the instance {tool}.
govulncheck_not_called: {count} more in required or imported code that is never called (not findings)
govulncheck_limitation_reachable: Only vulnerabilities whose symbol the code reaches are findings; the Go vulnerability database has no severity, so a reachable one blocks with an unknown severity.
govulncheck_condition_network: Network: the Go vulnerability database (vuln.go.dev) is fetched, and the modules missing from the module cache are downloaded.
